name: seodraft
description: Run your seodraft content pipeline from Orca: pipeline, content map, evidence, profile, agent routines and a feed of what your agents do in seodraft.

settings.title: seodraft MCP URL
settings.description: The seodraft MCP endpoint the plugin talks to.

settings.title: OAuth callback port
settings.description: Local port that receives the sign-in callback on 127.0.0.1. Changing it asks you to connect again.

settings.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the status bar item re-reads the pipeline.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: Agent that routines and "Ask agent to fix" start with.

settings.title: MCP server name
settings.description: Name your agents use for the seodraft MCP server.

settings.title: Paid call ceiling (USD)
settings.description: Refuse an agent's seodraft call whose estimated cost is above this. 0 turns the guard off; blocks only in Claude Code.

settings.title: Approve maps and profiles from the panel only
settings.description: Refuse an agent's approve_content_map, approve_profile and add_cluster_topics calls, so those approvals happen in this panel. Blocks only in Claude Code.

settings.title: Notify when posts are ready for review
settings.description: Show a desktop notification when more posts are waiting for your review than last time.
